8b2c6a92c8b781acbde8ab213a1cfa9135b7f8c4.reject: Not a per-year annual-mean series despite superficially year-like column suffixes. Uncor/Local/Natio are a raw reading and two bias-adjustment factors (Local≈0.68, Natio≈0.77 in row 1, i.e. within the normal 0-1 range for a diffusion-tube bias-adjustment factor), and the columns that follow are simple products of those on the SAME row, not later years' data: loc_1 = Uncor×Local = 78×0.68 = 53.04, Nat_1 = Uncor×Natio = 78×0.77 = 60.06, and Nat_12 = Uncor_1×Natio_1 = 76.1×0.87 = 66.207 (all exact matches on row 1 of the sample). The loc_/Nat_/Uncor_/Local_/Natio_ columns, with cryptic and sometimes-collided ArcGIS-truncated suffixes (_1, _12, _12_13, _12_13_14, _12_13_14_15, with 'Natio_12_13_14' appearing twice and a stray 'Loc_2'), are successive raw readings and bias-adjustment factors from a diffusion-tube QA/calibration exercise, not one column per calendar year. F1..F1_12_13_14 pick the chosen adjusted figure from each of those periods, and Number_not/sum_/average, alongside Worst_Case/In_AQMA_/Com_Act_Ar, compute a rolling multi-period average feeding an AQMA compliance screening decision - a derived compliance metric, not the source's own published annual mean for a single year. No column can be reliably assigned to one calendar year from the header text alone, so nothing here can be mapped without guessing.
